notice: Illustrative portfolio sample; not the output of a live API run.
problem: Design an automated QA pipeline for controlled AI image generation to prevent character face drift across multiple camera angles.

approach.name: Identity Embedding Gate
approach.summary: Validate every generated frame against approved identity references and reject outputs below a calibrated similarity threshold.
approach.key_mechanism: Reference embeddings, pose-aware thresholds, targeted regeneration, and a final approval gate.

evaluations.rationale: The mechanism is measurable, automatable, and directly connected to identity consistency.
evaluations.improvement: Calibrate separate thresholds for frontal, profile, and high-occlusion views.

final_plan.title: Identity-Consistency QA Pipeline
final_plan.executive_summary: Create approved multi-angle references, measure identity similarity after generation, and route failed frames through targeted regeneration before final approval.
final_plan.why_this_plan: It combines an automated quality gate with reference coverage for difficult camera angles and keeps every decision testable.

action_steps.action: Create and approve a multi-angle identity reference pack.
action_steps.acceptance_test: The pack contains approved frontal, three-quarter, profile, and difficult-angle references.

action_steps.action: Implement similarity scoring and targeted regeneration for failed frames.
action_steps.acceptance_test: Known drift examples fail while approved validation frames pass at the calibrated threshold.

failure_controls.failure_mode: Profile views receive false rejection scores.
failure_controls.early_signal: Reject rate increases sharply for profile poses.
failure_controls.control: Use pose-aware thresholds and profile-specific references.

success_metrics: Average regeneration attempts per accepted frame
first_72_hours: Create a small multi-angle validation dataset.
Implement and benchmark a baseline similarity check.
